articles.title: Man City 5-0 West Ham, Chelsea 1-1 Everton: Reigning WSL champions make title statement as Bunny Shaw scores hat-trick
articles.summary: WSL round-up as Man City thumped West Ham including a Bunny Shaw hat-trick; Chelsea were held to a disappointing draw with Everton, surrendering top spot as they try to reclaim the title they lost to City last season
articles.body:
Aoba ​Fujino ​and Iman Beney scored City's other goals in a dominant display that underlined their intent to claim back-to-back titles, now two points clear of Chelsea after the Blues laboured to a disappointing 1-1 draw with Everton.

City made the most ​of that slip-up, led by the eminent Shaw, who took her personal tally to a staggering 12 goals in eight starts this term. She had team-mates to thank for finding her in such promising positions, including another assist for Lauren Hemp, but the ruthlessness of Shaw's finishing showed impeccable composure and class.

Sonia Bompastor's Chelsea, meanwhile, were guilty of wasting their opportunities, eventually caught out by the tricky Toffees despite taking an early lead. Lucy Bronze was involved heavily at both ends, nodding Katie McCabe's cross onto the head of Sandy Baltimore to score before being stung five minutes later.

Yuka Momiki swung a cross into the box and Bronze's attempted clearance miscued horribly into her own net. In a strange quirk, it's the third time Scott Phelan's side have benefited from an own goal to claim at least a point in a game. They failed to land a single shot on target of their own.

Bunny Shaw has taken her extraordinary scoring form to elevated heights this season. Currently on her best run of consecutive scoring starts (nine) in the league, the Jamaica international has now hit the target in 14 of 20 appearances in 2026.

Her total for the season is 12 already. At this rate, she is set to smash the competition record of 22 in a single campaign, jointly owned by Viv Miedema and Rachel Daly. She's averaging a goal every 61 minutes. Irrepressible.

And totally irreplaceable. This latest showcase was a masterclass of elite finishing. Left foot, bullet header, right foot. While Shaw remains in such a rich vein of creative form, City are as good as unbeatable.

"We intended to score a lot of goals," she told Sky Sports afterwards. Her treble takes her up to 95 in total, two off the all-time WSL record. She will surely be the first to reach 100.

Fortune was not so favourable for Lucy Bronze . The day started well as she assisted Chelsea's well-worked opener from a corner, but her mistake also gifted Everton an equaliser, making for two points dropped. In a two-horse title race those types of stumbles tend to be punishing.

Perhaps Chelsea's real oversight was a failure at the other end of the pitch. Their dominance was evident in the numbers, with an xG value over two, 55 touches in Everton's box, eight shots on target and three big chances. Only one conversion from such pressure and control is pretty abject.

"Even when we shot on target we were not clinical enough, not ruthless enough," said Bompastor. "And I don't think we made Everton's goalkeeper work hard enough."

Her side surrender top spot as a result. And City will be reticent to hand any initiative back.

articles.title: Birmingham 2-1 Swansea: Jay Stansfield scores twice as Blues go top of the Championship
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Birmingham and Swansea at St Andrew's on Saturday; Jay Stansfield scores twice against 10-man Swans as the Blues go top of the table.
articles.body:
Stansfield struck three minutes from time after a Christoph Klarer own goal had cancelled out his first-half opener for the Blues.

Ryan Allsop saved Ross Stewart's early Swansea penalty after the referee felt Jenson Seelt had been shoved over by Alex Cochrane from the first corner of the match.

Goncalo Franco headed against the post as Swansea continued to dominate the early exchanges.

But the referee intervened again, this time sending off Marko Stamenic for a high challenge on Ethan Laird.

Birmingham quickly capitalised on their advantage as they opened the scoring on the half hour mark through Stansfield.

Max Bird was played in behind the defence and was able to play a simple square pass to Stansfield, who produced a clinical finish.

Stansfield soon had a chance to double the lead but Lawrence Vigouroux stood strong and made an excellent point blank save.

Just before the half-time whistle, the Swansea keeper was forced into action again, making an impressive double save.

With Swansea down to 10, Birmingham were able to maintain control of the game during the second half.

There were loud appeals for a penalty when Laird looked like he was tripped in the box but the full-back only earned a yellow card for simulation.

Despite the home side's dominance in possession, the Swans remained in the game and took their chance to equalise from a corner through Klarer's unfortunate own goal.

The Birmingham crowd were becoming increasingly frustrated by their team's lack of urgency.

Meanwhile, Swansea's substitutes continued to make an impression.

It took a set piece at the other end for Birmingham to finally get their noses in front again. Once again it was Stansfield taking centre stage.

The ball fell to him in the box after a ricochet and Vigouroux could do nothing about his powerful deflected strike.

"It's great to be at the summit and to have touched the summit of this league with everything we've been through and the whole journey.

"I was really disappointed with the penalty. I've watched it back so many times and I just can't understand why the referee's given that. I mean it's incredible, the lad's just thrown himself on the floor."

"You need to play to win no matter what situation you are in. That's the real heart and soul of a good team. Find ways to compete and find ways to stay competitive, whatever the context is.

"Unfortunately, sometimes life is like that, you get knocks. It's up to us to find ways to bounce back again. When I look to the performance, I have no doubt that that will happen."

articles.title: Odegaard resuelve y el Arsenal, líder en solitario al parón
articles.standfirst: El noruego anotó el único tanto en un partido cerrado
articles.summary: El noruego anotó el único tanto en un partido cerrado
articles.body: Apenas cinco goles encajados en esta Premier League y cuatro porterías a cero consecutivas en la liga inglesa. El Arsenal tiró de bloque, y del talento de Martin Odegaard, para resolver en casa ante el Hull City. Los de Arteta se impusieron con un escueto 1-0 que resultó suficiente para irse al parón de selecciones con, al menos, tres puntos sobre el segundo... por ahora, el Manchester City. El partido, no obstante, tardó en arrancar. Lo mejor de la primera parte en el Emirates fue el 'troleo' del árbitro Farai Hallam a la hinchada del Arsenal en el tramo final del mismo. Cuando todo apuntaba a un escueto 0-0 al descanso, con un Arsenal plano y sin excesivo interés por acelerar, el colegiado fue al VAR a revisar un posible penalti de Nobel Mendy sobre Havertz por agarrón. Y tras mirar la pantalla, cuando se puso a explicarlo a todo el estadio, siguió el orden estricto de la cronología: reconoció el agarrón, levantando la ovación del público, para acabar diciendo que, sin embargo, Havertz estaba en fuera de juego y eso anulaba la acción. Fue lo más entretenido de un primer tiempo que dejó una gran mano de Raya ante Stroud y un disparo desviado de Declan Rice. El Arsenal, lider, dejaba que desear días después de ganar en República Checa al Slavia de Praga en Champions. Pero el paso de los minutos hizo madurar el partido con un Hull City que, viendo el 0-0 posible, dio un paso atrás. Suficiente para que el Arsenal, casi por inercia y con alguna acción individual, empezará a rondar el gol. Y este, el 1-0, llegó en el 72' tras un disparo de Madueke que no ataja Tzolakis. El rechace, siendo el más rápido de la clase, lo transformó en un tanto decisivo Odegaard. No pasó más en el Emirates. El Hull City tuvo un arreón más por orgullo que por talento y el Arsenal se defendió bien. Tres puntos que se quedaban en Londres.

articles.title: Arsenal 1-0 Hull City: Martin Odegaard breaks Tigers' resistance to clinch victory for Premier League champions
articles.summary: Report and highlights as Arsenal go six points clear thanks to Martin Odegaard's 72nd-minute goal against Hull; Arsenal were controversially denied a penalty by VAR before their breakthrough; Man City's loss to Nottingham Forest ensures healthy lead for Gunners
articles.body:
Hull defended resolutely for over an hour at the Emirates Stadium but the pressure told when Odegaard reacted quickest to convert a rebound after Konstantinos Tzolakis had saved from Noni Madueke.

Arsenal struggled to create clear openings for much of the contest and lacked cutting edge in the first half as Kai Havertz wasted a one-on-one chance and Christos Tzolis spurned opportunities.

The hosts were also controversially denied a penalty following a VAR check when Havertz was adjudged to have been offside as his shirt was pulled by Nobel Mendy near the end of the first period.

According to Premier League rules, however, the foul by Mendy should have taken precedence as Havertz was not "attempting to play the ball, or challenging for the ball" as he made his run, meaning the penalty should have been awarded.

Hull were difficult to break down and went close to an opener when Elliot Stroud forced a fine save from a full-stretch David Raya, but Arsenal stepped up the intensity in the second half and eventually made the all-important breakthrough.

Odegaard's goal, his first since a run of four in five games between August and September, extended their lead over second-placed Manchester City, whose defeat to Nottingham Forest puts the Gunners in a commanding position in the title race.

They could have added to their lead late on when Madueke was unable to convert a one-on-one chance and the loose ball had to be hacked off Hull's goal-line, but a 34th 1-0 win under Arteta ensures their strong start to the season continues.

Dean: Why Arsenal should have had a penalty

Former Premier League referee Mike Dean on Soccer Saturday:

"I've kind of got sucked into listening what is going on with the VAR, working out offside, shirt pull, and what happened last week at Liverpool.

"Havertz is an offside position but doesn't go and challenge for the ball, so it's not an offence. Before he can go and challenge for the ball the shirt pull also occurs so the foul is before the offside.

"Because he doesn't go and challenge for the ball, the first offence is the shirt pull. Now, for me, the shirt pull is probably a bit worse than last week. He holds it a lot longer.

"Last week was a shirt pull, let go, this was like a prolonged hold. I still don't think he would have got nowhere near the ball. The ball is probably five, 10 yards away from where he is, but they send him to the screen to look at it and they've obviously explained, the VAR to the referee, that he's offside first which is wrong.

"It should have been a restart with a penalty, not an offside."

Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta speaking to Sky Sports:

"We had some big moments that we should have scored and we didn't hit the target, get the final pass, we are one-on-one with the 'keeper and don't take the chance.

"So many situations where you don't do that, you need to rely on generating so much volume and at some point, hoping that you're going to get them down and that's the way we won the game.

"To get a result and the kind of performance we gave today is very important. We need to praise our players for the way they go about every game and what we've done since the first international break up to now with the games that we had and the amount of points we have."

On Noni Madueke: "It's a great example for the dressing room because before the first international break, he wasn't playing and instead of going on holiday, he went to Portugal to get somebody to train with him and get him in better condition.

"Immediately he was in the rhythm and now he is full of confidence, you can see that. He is trying things, running past players, impacting games with goals and assists and we are very happy."

On Havertz's penalty shout: "I was confused because when the referee went to the monitor, it was because it was a clear penalty but they made a different decision based on the offside. We haven't got any clarity yet about the situation."

Analysis: Konsa sums up Arsenal solidity

This was not a vintage attacking display from Arsenal but defensively there were few faults. Their seventh clean sheet in 10 Premier League games, and 10th in 16 overall, owed a lot to their centre-back pairing. Gabriel and Ezri Konsa excelled again.

William Saliba's impending return will put pressure on Konsa to retain his place but on current form he may keep hold of the shirt. Highlights from his display included a last-ditch block on Mohamed Ali-Cho when was suddenly exposed on the break.

There was no self-congratulation afterwards. Instead he berated the referee for a perceived Hull foul, then got on with business. By the end of the game, he had won all seven of his duels and completed all but two of his 53 passes, a picture of composure.

He is making an immense contribution at the club. Arsenal had one early scare when Stroud forced a save from Raya but it is now 444 minutes without conceding a goal in the Premier League.

Odegaard won it but Konsa did his bit too.

Hull head coach Sergej Jakirovic speaking to Sky Sports:

"We were brave, especially in the defensive phase. We didn't allow a lot of space. Sometimes we lost duels and they had good transitions.

"On the ball, we needed much better decisions to be braver and quicker transitions. If we had this, then we'd be more dangerous.

"We had some good chances but they stopped them."

Jakirovic was right to praise his side's bravery. But this game was a reminder that bravery will only get you so far. They lacked the quality to really trouble Arsenal in the final third, apart from when Stroud's curling shot tested Raya in the early stages.

Mohamed Belloumi was missed. The Algeria international has been a revelation this season, either scoring or assisting five of Hull's 11 Premier League goals. Without his creativity and imagination in the final third, their task was made far harder.

Jakirovic revealed Belloumi hadn't trained since the 2-2 draw with Ipswich due to an injury and said will not join up with Algeria during the international break as he works on his rehabilitation. Hull are going to need him for the challenges ahead.

Arsenal have 27 points from their opening 10 Premier League games this season (W9 L1). Only Chelsea in 2005/06, Manchester City in 2011/12, Manchester City in 2017/18 and Liverpool in 2019/20 have had more at the same stage.

Arsenal have kept a clean sheet in seven of their opening 10 Premier League games this season, only Birmingham City in 2003/04, Chelsea in 2004/05 and Manchester United in 2017/18 have had more at this stage, with eight.

This was Arsenal's 34th 1-0 win under Mikel Arteta in the Premier League, more than any other side in the competition since his first game in charge in December 2019.

Arsenal have won each of their last 10 home games in all competitions; only enjoying a longer run under Mikel Arteta in November 2022 (12).

articles.title: Fulham 1-1 Newcastle: Rodrigo Muniz rescues point for hosts after Jacob Murphy's stunner at Craven Cottage
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights as Rodrigo Muniz snatches point for Fulham after Jacob Murphy's stunner gave Newcastle lead at Craven Cottage, in first ever Premier League draw between the two in London
articles.body:
The heat had began to ramp up on the German boss after the Magpies were booed off at the end of a limp home defeat to Everton on Monday night but a chalk-and-cheese showing in west London lacked only the three points in a game they arguably shaded.

Newcastle thought they had earned a first-half lead when Dan Burn nodded home from a corner but his celebrations in front of his old fans were cut short with Yoane Wissa penalised for a shirt pull on Timothy Castagne, a decision which left Jaissle fuming.

There would have been no need for that VAR intervention had Harvey Barnes buried his chance when played in behind moments earlier, but aimed hisfinish too close to Bernd Leno when clean through.

The best Fulham could muster, despite their territorial dominance, was a Josh King volley and a glancing header from their internationally-recognised teenager, as their recent struggles in front of goal continued.

The game appeared to be drifting towards a first draw between these two in 19 Premier League meetings in the capital, until a loose pass from Cesar Palacios across midfield allowed Murphy to run at Antonee Robinson before turning inside and unleashing an unstoppable effort beyond Leno.

The relief in Jaissle's celebration was evident but was only a brief respite with Fulham's messy equaliser coming only three minutes later, as Palacios' pass deflected into the path of Muniz and his inventive flick beat Lukas Hornicek with some help from Burn.

It was his first Premier League goal in seven months but came at the perfect time to rescue a point for the hosts, and deny Jaissle a win he would have found so personally valuable.

"I learned that here, the phrase 'soft decision'. That's what I meant.

"Without taking it as an excuse, last week we had an occasion where [Fabian Schar] was bleeding in the face and to have this as a comparison, it's difficult to understand but that's my point of view without paying any fines."

Arbeloa delighted with Muniz contribution

"I felt the game was there for [Muniz]. They were marking us man-to-man, we had the space in front and they forced us to play long balls. Rodrigo is very strong in this situation.

"He scored a goal but they couldn't stop him without fouls. He's very important for us and for me."

articles.title: Illinois' Bret Bielema Shades SEC Over CFP Rankings in Video, Responds to Fan on Social Media
articles.summary: Illinois' Bret Bielema is the latest Big Ten head coach to take umbrage with the SEC's dominance in the initial College Football Playoff rankings that came out this week.
articles.body:
Illinois' Bret Bielema is the latest Big Ten head coach to take umbrage with the SEC's dominance in the initial College Football Playoff rankings that came out this week.

Following the Illini's 24-13 win over Nebraska on Friday, Bielema joked with reporters their 6-3 record would "probably" have them ranked as a top-15 team if they were in the SEC.

After a fan on social media tried to ask why Illinois avoided scheduling an SEC opponent, Bielema responded that didn't happen because they decided to do a home-and-home with Notre Dame.

Bielema's comments come after Indiana's Curt Cignetti laughed when he was asked about the CFP Top 25 during his radio show on Wednesday.

"These people, and there's a whole bunch of them, they march out of the tent and they're given instructions on what to say and they follow the company line," he said in an apparent reference to the love the SEC received in the rankings and the conference's coverage. "And I don't need to go any further."

The College Football Playoff rankings are often subject to scrutiny, but the first reveal this season seemed to attract more attention than normal.

There are three two-loss SEC teams ranked among the top 10. Two of them — Alabama and Texas — are ahead of undefeated UCLA and one-loss BYU. The third — Mississippi — is one spot in front of Notre Dame, whose lone defeat was against BYU.

It doesn't help that there's no apparent logic among the ranking of SEC teams. For instance, Alabama (No. 5) is ranked eight spots ahead of Tennessee (No. 13) even though the Volunteers beat the Crimson Tide 26-10 on Oct. 17.

Based on the initial playoff rankings, the SEC would have five of the 12 spots. The Big Ten would have two representatives, but Ohio State at No. 12 would be squeezed out in favor of Boise State as the highest-ranked Group of Five team.

Illinois has won four straight games to become bowl eligible for the third consecutive year. The Illini will look to keep their positive momentum going next week against the Bruins at the Rose Bowl.

articles.title: Arsenal 1-0 Hull City: How the players rated
articles.summary: How Arsenal and Hull City's players rated following their Premier League match at Emirates Stadium.
articles.body:
Odegaard hits winner as Arsenal beat Hull to extend lead at top

What do BBC Sport's player ratings mean?

Arsenal needed a late goal from Martin Odegaard to beat a stubborn Hull side at Emirates Stadium.

The Gunners, who thought they should have been awarded a penalty in the first half, looked like they would be frustrated by the Tigers before Odegaard followed up Noni Madueke's shot to tap in the winner.

Here's how I rated the players and you can see how you scored them below.

articles.title: Larrubia: "Estamos con Funes hasta el final"
articles.standfirst: El '10' del Málaga defiende al entrenador
articles.summary: El '10' del Málaga defiende al entrenador
articles.body: David Larrubia no escondió su preocupación después de una nueva derrota del Málaga CF, esta vez ante el Racing de Santander (1-2) en La Rosaleda. El futbolista malagueño compareció en zona mixta con un discurso marcado por la autocrítica, la defensa del vestuario y el compromiso de seguir peleando para cambiar una dinámica que empieza a pesar en Martiricos. El atacante reconoció, además, que tampoco atraviesa su mejor momento individual. "Me está costando, no tengo problema en reconocerlo", admitió el jugador del barrio de La Luz, que aseguró estar trabajando tanto en el apartado físico como en el mental para recuperar su mejor versión. "Estoy trabajando mucho el tema mental y el físico. No estoy en mi mejor momento, pero espero y sigo trabajando para que pueda llegar", explicó. Sobre el encuentro ante el Racing, lamentó especialmente el golpe recibido nada más comenzar la segunda mitad y la posterior expulsión. El vestuario había preparado el regreso al terreno de juego con la intención de proteger la ventaja, pero todo se torció en apenas unos minutos. "Estamos muy jodidos dentro del vestuario", confesó. Pese a ello, quiso rescatar la reacción del Málaga incluso en inferioridad numérica: "El equipo con uno menos sigue teniendo sus ocasiones, sigue estando en el partido, sigue creyendo y dejándose el alma". Uno de los mensajes más contundentes de Larrubia llegó cuando fue preguntado por la figura de Juanfran Funes. El atacante no dejó espacio para las dudas y expresó el respaldo del vestuario al entrenador lojeño, cuestionado por la mala trayectoria del equipo. "Claro que estamos con Funes. Funes nos ha traído hasta aquí. El equipo va a ir con Funes hasta el final", aseguró. El futbolista defendió la propuesta del técnico y los valores que ha transmitido al grupo desde su llegada. "Nos ha inculcado unos valores y un juego que nos beneficia. Nosotros vamos a morir por el escudo, por el míster y por toda esta gente que viene y llena La Rosaleda cada fin de semana", añadió. El mensaje también tuvo como destinataria a una afición que volvió a mostrar su descontento tras otra tarde sin premio. Larrubia fue especialmente sincero al reconocer que el equipo no está correspondiendo al apoyo recibido: "No puedo pedirle nada a la afición. La afición nos está dando y nosotros no le estamos dando a ella".

articles.title: Watch Oklahoma HSFB Teams Decide Playoff Fates with Coin Toss in Restaurant Parking Lot
articles.summary: This year's Oklahoma high school football playoff picture came down to a literal coin toss.
articles.body:
This year's Oklahoma high school football playoff picture came down to a literal coin toss.

Three programs on the bubble of the state's playoff picture determined which two schools would head to the postseason in a late night coin toss, according to a video shared by Tulsa Football's Jeremie Poplin.

The toss-up between Gore, Liberty and Central high schools took place in the parking lot outside a catfish restaurant, per 2 News Oklahoma's TJ Eckert. The results sent Liberty and Central to the postseason.

The coin toss took place after the three programs finished the season even in tiebreakers including head-to-head results and point differentials, per KOCO News 5's Jonathan Greco .

This isn't the first time a game of chance has determined a high school football playoff spot. Last November, a coin toss in a Texas parking lot between representatives of Amarillo, Lubbock and Caprock high schools decided the results of their district's postseason race.

articles.body:
Última hora del Valencia - Real Madrid en directo

Muuuuuuuuy buenas nocheeees. El Real Madrid se despide de Mestalla . Los de Mourinho disputan su último encuentro en el mítico estadio del Valencia con ganas de mantener y ampliar su racha de victorias, que de momento está en siete. Partidos casi todos ellos muy duros, definidos al final por un equipo que parece haber recuperado el gen competitivo que ha distinguido históricamente a los equipos del club blanco.

El Madrid visita otra 'caldera', otro de esos estadios en los que el ambiente pesa. Las gradas casi verticales de Mestalla volverán a poner a prueba el temple de los blancos pese a la baja de Vinicius, que inevitablemente restará algo de tensión a la presencia del Madrid en Valencia . Pero Mestalla no es un campo fácil para los blancos. En las últimas diez temporadas, pese a la pujanza del Madrid (sobre todo en la Champions) y la crisis de identidad del Valencia, el balance es equilibrado: cuatro victorias locales, cuatro visitantes y dos empates.

El Valencia sabe que el oxígeno que le dio la victoria en Elche se le puede escapar en esta jornada dependiendo de su resultado y de lo que hagan los rivales directos por la salvación. Penúltimo en la tabla , con nueve puntos, el parón de selecciones puede resultar especialmente incómodo dependiendo de las sensaciones que deje el paso por Mestalla del Real Madrid . Javier Aguirre ensayó durante la semana con una defensa de cinco en un once en el que Rioja apunta a convertirse en el principal damnificado de la semana. El técnico blanquinegro apostará por Danjuma y Sadiq en ataque, asistente y goleador en el último encuentro de Liga, con la idea de dar continuidad a algunos de los movimientos que funcionaron para lograr la primera victoria del entrenador mexicano desde que se sentó en el banquillo de Mestalla para sustituir a Carlos Corberán .

Enseguida tenemos noticias desde Mestalla, conocemos los onces y analizamos la previa como se merece un partido de esta altura. No esperamos más y arrrrrrrancamooooooos.

articles.title: Un Espanyol distinto se topa con Leo Román
articles.standfirst: No pudo sumar el triunfo en el primer partido del proyecto Sarabia como local
articles.summary: No pudo sumar el triunfo en el primer partido del proyecto Sarabia como local
articles.body: El Espanyol empató a cero ante el Deportivo en el RCDE Stadium. Pese a gozar de buenas ocasiones en el primer tiempo, el equipo perico se topó con un inspirado Leo Román, que aunque ha sido objeto de críticas en las últimas jornadas, firmó un gran partido. Un punto que sabe a poco en este primer partido del nuevo proyecto blanquiazul, pero en el que se pudo ver la idea del técnico perico. Aún no pudo sentarse en el banquillo del RCDE Stadium Eder Sarabia, que vio el encuentro desde uno de los palcos. La propuesta fue bastante distinta a lo que venía mostrando el Espanyol con Manolo González, acumulando el conjunto perico casi un 70% de posesión y combinaciones bastante interesantes que a punto estuvieron de acabar en gol. Unos conceptos que no ha tardado mucho en asimilar la plantilla perica. Lo más destacable del día fue la pequeña revolución en el once blanquiazul que implantó el cuerpo técnico del Espanyol, con Jon López a la cabeza. Cambios notables tanto en el esquema como en los nombres elegidos para salir de inicio. Una defensa de tres centrales atrás y futbolistas como Pere Milla o Calatrava en ataque, jugadores últimamente con pocos minutos, teniendo mucho peso en el equipo en detrimento de otros como Javi Hernández o Bryan Zaragoza. El Espanyol tendrá ahora unas semanas para poder trabajar antes de visitar al Athletic Club la próxima jornada. Un parón que aprovechará el equipo para realizar una pequeña pretemporada en la Garrotxa para seguir trabajando en la nueva idea que Sarabia quiere implementar en el Espanyol. Por el momento, futbolísticamente se pudieron ver cosas interesantes pero ha faltado lo esencial, el gol.

articles.title: Hidalgo: “Leo Román nos ha sostenido en el partido”
articles.standfirst: Destacó la actuación de su guardameta y se mostró satisfecho con el empate
articles.summary: Destacó la actuación de su guardameta y se mostró satisfecho con el empate
articles.body: Antonio Hidalgo no se mostró muy satisfecho de la actuación del colegiado del partido Quintero González. “Hubo situaciones arbitrales que no estoy de acuerdo con ellas pero en líneas generales es un buen punto”, expresó el catalán. Del partido aseguró que hicieron buenos minutos en el choque pero tuvieron fallos que pudieron significar algún gol. “Estoy contento con el punto y con la portería a cero hoy en el partido teníamos que intuir porque no sabíamos cómo jugaría el español y creo que estoy contento porque competimos que eso es lo importante”. El Dépor suma cuatro puntos de seis posibles y se sitúa en la zona media alta de la tabla. Hidalgo cree que es un campo muy difícil y da por bueno el empate. “Hemos estado muy incómodos durante el partido los equipos de Eder Sarabia son muy intensos y te estresan mucho”.

articles.title: New Jersey HS girls soccer coach suspended for celebrating milestone win by popping champagne bottle
articles.summary: Paul VI's Karen Anderson will miss Monday's playoff game as her team seeks a third straight state title.
articles.body:
The head coach of New Jersey's top-ranked girls high school soccer team has been suspended for one game after a social media video showed her celebrating a milestone win by popping a champagne bottle on school grounds.

Karen Anderson of Paul VI High School won her 100th career match on Thursday, defeating Notre Dame 2-0 in the South Jersey, Non-Public A quarterfinals. In the since-deleted Instagram video, the bottle is handed to her by a group of parents who had set up a postgame celebration. After Anderson pops the bottle, she places it back on the table without drinking from it.

"I'm not surprised that it is coming to light given our success," Anderson told NJ.com . "It's really unfortunate that there are people out there looking for an opportunity to ruin all the hard work that I've put into this program."

According to the New Jersey State Interscholastic Athletic Association , "Players and coaches involved with alcohol/tobacco/illegal substances during or after the game at the game site or on school property, including chartered busses, shall be suspended from NJSIAA tournament play for one year and be denied any championship rights."

To avoid the harsher penalty laid out in the rulebook, Paul VI worked with the NJSIAA to limit the punishment to a single game as Anderson and her team vie for a third straight state title.

"While Coach Anderson did not consume the contents of the bottle, Paul VI does not condone this behavior and recognizes the importance of upholding the standards of conduct expected of our coaches," the school said in a statement to NJ.com .

Paul VI currently sports a 21-1 record on the season and along with being the No. 1-ranked team in the state , the Eagles are also ranked 16th nationally, according to a United Soccer Coaches poll. Last season the team finished 24-0 and won the Non-Public A state title for the second straight year.

The suspension will force Anderson to miss Monday's sectional semifinal against Immaculata.

articles.title: Nebraska fires offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen after loss to Illinois drops Huskers to 5-4
articles.summary: The Huskers have lost four straight games.
articles.body:
A fourth straight loss has led to the dismissal of Nebraska offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen.

A day after Nebraska lost 24-13 at Illinois, coach Matt Rhule announced that he had fired the former Houston and West Virginia coach.

"Like so many of you, I am angry, I am disappointed and I am frustrated with our results this season," Rhule said in a statement. "As the head coach, I am ultimately responsible for every aspect of our program — including wins and losses — and it is my responsibility to make changes when they are warranted. "While there are many areas that need improvement, our offensive plan and execution is simply not working. Earlier today, I relieved offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen of his duties. As I have recently shared, Dana has a fantastic offensive mind, he is a strong leader, and he has done great work here at Nebraska. But simply, we need a change. Co-offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach Glenn Thomas will take over play-calling duties."

"Like so many of you, I am angry, I am disappointed and I am frustrated with our results this season," Rhule said in a statement. "As the head coach, I am ultimately responsible for every aspect of our program — including wins and losses — and it is my responsibility to make changes when they are warranted.

"While there are many areas that need improvement, our offensive plan and execution is simply not working. Earlier today, I relieved offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen of his duties. As I have recently shared, Dana has a fantastic offensive mind, he is a strong leader, and he has done great work here at Nebraska. But simply, we need a change. Co-offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach Glenn Thomas will take over play-calling duties."

After wins over Michigan State and Maryland pushed Nebraska to 5-0, the Cornhuskers have struggled once their Big Ten schedule got tougher. Nebraska has lost to Indiana, Oregon, Washington and now the Illini over the past four games.

The offense has been a big reason for that losing streak. After Nebraska scored at least 31 points in each of its first five games of the season, the Huskers haven't scored more than 17 points in any of the past four games. And three of those losses have all come by just one score.

Nebraska scored 13 points Friday night despite totaling 426 yards and averaging 5.8 yards per play.

It's been a familiar season for Nebraska fans as the team has again struggled to capitalize on early-season success. The Huskers will be favored in Week 11 at Rutgers, but if Nebraska doesn't get to a sixth win and bowl eligibility next week, the postseason might be a lost cause. Nebraska ends the season with games against No. 12 Ohio State and No. 19 Iowa.

articles.title: Tottenham to submit complaint to Pro Ref over Jayden Bogle's tackle on Mathys Tel in Leeds win at Elland Road
articles.summary: Spurs are to submit complaint to Pro Ref over Jayden Bogle's tackle on Mathys Tel; Bogle caught Tel on his Achilles, but referee John Brooks did not punish the incident further; VAR Tony Harrington opted against recommending an on-field review
articles.body:
Bogle caught Tel on his Achilles, which was awarded as a foul, but referee John Brooks did not punish the incident further as the Leeds defender escaped without even a caution. Tel was unable to continue and was substituted before half-time.

A four-minute VAR review then ensued, but Tony Harrington opted against recommending an on-field review, with the challenge only deemed "reckless" as Tel was forced off injured as a result.

Ex-Premier League referee Mike Dean believed Bogle's tackle was "100 per cent a red", adding: "He has caught him right down the back of the Achilles. It is not a good tackle at all. I would be astounded if John Brooks is not sent to the screen."

The first-half incident comes just a week after Crystal Palace's Jean-Philippe Mateta was sent off for a similar challenge in Spurs' win over the Eagles.

Asked if he would have liked the referee to go to the pitchside monitor, Spurs boss Roberto De Zerbi said: "No, I have big confidence in the referee. Nothing changes if he goes to watch the clip or not.

"There was the VAR, and if they didn't take the right decision, I don't know, but we have confidence.

"We have to keep our eyes on the performance where we can improve."

He added in his post-match press conference: "I don't know if it was a red card or not on Mathys Tel, but for sure Pedro Porro yellow card [for his second-half challenge on Nmecha].

"And why I'm telling like this is because the parameter of the referee was not good enough, I think, for both these situations."

articles.title: Dardo de Casadó: "Los rivales saben quién viene de lesión y dónde la tiene”
articles.standfirst: El jugador del Deportivo se quejó en DAZN de una acción casi al final del encuentro
articles.summary: El jugador del Deportivo se quejó en DAZN de una acción casi al final del encuentro
articles.body: Marc Casadó reapareció en un terreno de juego casi un mes después, una vez que ha superado una rotura de clavícula. El centrocampista del Deportivo, que se ha recuperado unas cuatro semanas antes de lo previsto, entró en el campo en el minuto 72 sustituyendo a Mario Soriano para disputar la recta final del encuentro antes los pericos. Al final del partido, lanzó en los micrófonos de DAZN un dardo a los jugadores del Espanyol por una acción que se produjo en los últimos minutos. "Los rivales saben quién viene de lesión y dónde la tiene. La picardía está en buscar la zona. Pero se queda ahí”, se quejó el deportivista. La afición del RCDE Stadium le pitó cuando salió al césped por su pasado en el Barcelona, algo que se tomó con naturalidad. "Estamos contentos con este punto. Yo ya sabía al campo que venía y que me iban a recibir así, no tengo ningún problema", comentó. Por otro lado, Leo Román, su compañero de equipo, celebró su primer encuentro sin recibir goles esta campaña. "Primera portería a cero, me hacía falta a mí también. La segunda es mejor parada, estoy contento. Cuando no he estado bien, el equipo me ha arropado y lo ha solucionado metiendo goles y hoy he querido estar a la altura. De pequeño lo trabajas, hoy he agradecido a la afición y al staff el apoyo de estos días", aseguró en DAZN.

images.caption: Casadó en una tángana que se formó en los últimos minutos del partido. LALIGA

articles.title: Women's Super League: How Man City leapfrogged Chelsea before WSL showdown
articles.summary: Champions Manchester City will travel to Chelsea next week on top of the pile after a decisive Saturday in the Women's Super League.
articles.body:
Level on points at the top of the Women's Super League, there was little to separate Chelsea and Manchester City in the title race as they kicked off their respective matches at the same time on Saturday.

At that stage, Chelsea were edging the reigning champions thanks to a comfortably better goal difference, built up via a ruthlessness in attack and a solid defence.

However, by full-time, the tables had turned with Sonia Bompastor's side forced to settle for a point in a 1-1 draw against Everton, despite dominating at Stamford Bridge.

While Chelsea struggled to put their chances away, Khadija Shaw - a summer transfer target for the Blues - was running riot at Joie Stadium, and her hat-trick inspired Manchester City to an emphatic 5-0 victory against West Ham, trimming the goal difference gap in the process.

The win moves City two points clear of Chelsea at the top, one week before the sides meet in a potential title decider.

Yet Shaw, who has scored 12 goals in nine league appearances this season and is two away from equalling Vivianne Miedema's all-time WSL record of 97 goals, is not getting carried away.

"There's a lot of games to play, a lot of twists and turns," she told Sky Sports.

"One game at a time. We've got Champions League midweek and then we go again. We have to focus on the task ahead and not get too complacent."

Shaw hat-trick helps Man City back to top of table

Bronze scores own goal as Chelsea held by Everton

Chelsea 'not at the races' as City 'click'

With Everton ranked eighth and West Ham placed 10th at the start of the day, both games - on paper - looked favourable for the league's top two sides.

At Stamford Bridge, the Toffees did not have a shot on target and had just three touches in their opponent's box, while Chelsea had 20 shots, an expected goals total of 2.14 and 55 touches in the Everton penalty area - to no avail.

At the other end, Lucy Bronze's unfortunate own goal ultimately cost them three points.

"We weren't quite on the same page today but I cannot fault anyone's effort," Chelsea captain Erin Cuthbert said.

"It's just one of those days where we're not at the races and we can't have too many of those if we want to be in a title race."

Bompastor's side resorted to hopeful crosses and shots from range, while they lacked creativity against a resilient Everton side.

The Blues were not helped by Lauren James' absence, the playmaker ruled out for at least five games after sustaining a hamstring injury in last weekend's 6-0 victory over Charlton.

In Manchester, City waited patiently for an opener against West Ham and once they got it - thanks to Shaw's composed finish - the floodgates opened.

Shaw and Lauren Hemp - despite both missing out on the 26-player Fifpro Women's World XI shortlist - are an unstoppable duo in City's attack, with City's first goal the fifth time they have combined in the WSL this season.

"It's hard to explain. We just click. It's a connection we've built over time," Hemp told BBC Radio 5 Live. "It's not always perfect, but with the standards we set for each other, naturally it's going to come."

Already a two-time Golden Boot winner, Shaw appears to be in the form of her life. Her 12 goals this season account for 44% of City's WSL strikes - but goals from Aoba Fujino and Iman Beney against West Ham suggest Jeglertz still has other options.

"Our depth is going to be crucial. We can put players on that can bring us to the next level," the City boss told BBC Radio 5 Live.

"We are going to need all players. Five games in two weeks. Some players are starting, some are finishing, some are supporting from the side.

"We are all very important for success and this showed in this game."

City to 'battle the whole way' to defend WSL title

Chelsea will not have to wait long for a chance to overhaul City as victory against the champions next Saturday would put them back in top spot.

"We need to move on quickly," Bompastor said. "This group has a lot of experience with that and we will go into the next game really prepared.

"When we are doing well, it's good not to go too high - when it doesn't work, it's good not to get too low."

City have won their past two games against Chelsea - including last season's FA Cup semi-final - but the club know from past experience that it is far too early in the season to be complacent.

In the 2023-24 campaign, City were three points clear at the WSL summit with just two games left to play, but they ended up losing the title on goal difference to Chelsea on the final day of the season.

"At the moment, I don't care about it so much," Jeglertz said when asked about Chelsea dropping points.

"Of course I don't want them to win, but we also know that to win this league, we have to battle the whole way.

"If we win all our games, we'll be fine but if we struggle, then of course it doesn't matter what other teams do."

articles.title: Argentina FA set to go to Cas after Fifa rejects appeals over 2026 World cup incidents
articles.summary: The Argentina Football Association says it is planning to go to the Court of Arbitration for Sport over Fifa rejecting its appeals against World Cup punishments.
articles.body:
The Argentina Football Association says it is planning to apply to the Court of Arbitration for Sport over Fifa rejecting its appeals against punishments handed out to the organisation and midfielder Leandro Paredes.

Paredes was given a 10-match ban for his role in on-field clashes following Argentina's 1-0 defeat by Spain in the 2026 World Cup final.

Team-mate Nahuel Molina was given a seven-game ban, with both players being fined $90,000 (£66,000), and while the AFA said Molina's suspension had been reduced to four games by Fifa, the sanctions on Paredes stood.

The AFA was fined $321,000 (£235,000) for breaches of the Fifa disciplinary code related to using a sports event for demonstrations of a non-sporting nature, team misconduct, and discriminatory chants and gestures by its supporters.

After beating England 2-1 in the World Cup semi-final, several Argentina players held up a banner claiming Argentine sovereignty over the Falkland Islands, a British overseas territory.

A statement from the AFA said that, as Fifa had upheld the punishments, its next step would be to ask for the reasons for the decisions by world football's governing body before taking the issue to Cas.

Following the Word Cup final in July, Argentina players Paredes, Molina and Thiago Almada plus assistant coach Roberto Ayala all appeared to be involved in a fracas on the pitch as Spain celebrated their win.

Paredes seemed to push Spain's Eric Garcia by the throat and unused substitute Gavi tried to intervene but was forced to the ground by Almada.

Fifa later appointed a disciplinary and ethics prosecutor to assess what happened before issuing its sanctions.

articles.title: Eder Sarabia: “Hemos merecido ganar claramente”
articles.standfirst: El técnico perico señalaba que el Espanyol fue mejor en el encuentro ante el Deportivo
articles.summary: El técnico perico señalaba que el Espanyol ha merecido más en el duelo ante le Deportivo
articles.body: El Espanyol ha empatado a cero en el encuentro disputado en el RCDE Stadium ante el Deportivo. Con Eder Sarabia en las gradas y con Jon López en el banquillo, el conjunto blanquiazul ha jugado un buen partido, en el que, sobre todo, en el primer tiempo ha dispuesto de buenas ocasiones para poder llevarse el duelo, pero se ha topado con un gran Leo Román. La segunda mitad ha sido más pareja, aunque se ha podido ver a un Espanyol distinto con muchos cambios en el equipo. Tras el encuentro, Sarabia señalaba ante los medios que el equipo ha merecido el triunfo. Un Espanyol merecedor del triunfo: “Yo creo que nos hemos impuesto claramente al rival, que ha estado incómodo, creo, en todo momento. No nos ha generado ninguna situación clara de gol. Nosotros, en cambio, sí. El portero ha sido el mejor de ellos. Hemos jugado mucho en campo contrario, hemos dominado bastante. Hemos recuperado la pelota bastante pronto. Y bueno, pues eso, lo que el equipo ha mostrado en el campo, la pena es que creo que hemos podido merecer esa victoria que no la hemos conseguido”. Una buena imagen, con aspectos a mejorar: “Bueno, en intención de lo que digo, de llevar el partido a campo contrario, de intentar recuperarla pronto, de que no nos toque demasiadas veces defender en repliegue, de tener alternativas, porque creo que también en algún contraataque hemos hecho daño, en algunas situaciones de juego directo también. A partir de ahí pues es verdad que todavía nos quedan cosas por trabajar. Con balón nos ha faltado encontrar las ventajas y a veces hacer un poco más de daño encontrando superioridades dentro. Bueno, evidentemente cosas que vamos a seguir puliendo, pero creo que el equipo ha dado una muy buena cara. Se ha hecho, se merece una nota muy alta y creo claramente que hemos merecido ganar”. Un once con muchos cambios: “Sí, un poco de todo, como haremos siempre, lo que vemos durante la semana, el perfil de futbolista que necesitamos dependiendo de la posición y lo que buscamos. Bueno, empezando por la defensa, pues queríamos dos jugadores fuera que pudieran perseguir, que pudieran salir fuera y poder defender sin problemas. Queríamos tener un central un poco más poderoso para el duelo con Nsongo. Dentro, sobre todo Cala, porque la verdad me ha gustado la semana suya de entrenamiento y creo que es un jugador que tiene gol junto con Pere, Roberto y los dos extremos, pues intentábamos ahí tener presencia. Luego tener energía también con Pol, por ejemplo, para las recuperaciones, para que nos ayudara en situaciones defensivas más que para adelante, para atrás. Los planes de partido irán variando, depende de los rivales, depende de momentos que entendamos”. Sobre Pere Milla, Roberto Fernández y Moscardo: “Pere Milla lo ha hecho bien, porque entiende bien el juego, porque es listo, porque tiene gol, le conozco muy bien. De hecho, lo hemos sufrido algunas veces en contra. Y bueno, para esa doble punta, pues la verdad es que hoy entendía que de inicio era el mejor jugador. Estamos abiertos a que cualquiera en el día a día nos muestre cosas. Le he visto bien. Roberto Fernández para mí ha elegido muy bien todas las situaciones de finalización. Para mí un delantero jamás tiene que ser egoísta. El egoísmo no es una buena cualidad. El delantero tiene que elegir bien. Y si cuando tiene que finalizar da el pase, pues no está del todo bien. Y si cuando tiene que dar pase, finaliza, tampoco está bien. Y creo que no es que haya sido generoso, sino que ha elegido bien. Ha finalizado la última con la zurda que casi es gol de Marcos. Ha generado dos situaciones que ha estado a punto de empujarlas el compañero. Se ha movido bien, ha trabajado bien, ha rematado ese balón de cabeza también espectacular que se lo ha sacado el portero abajo. Creo que ha hecho un gran partido. Moscardo tiene valentía para ofrecerse y jugar un poco para adelante por dentro, que creía que nos estaba costando un poco. Ayer en el entrenamiento, en el juego de posición que hicimos, jugando de pivote ahí, la verdad que hubo tres o cuatro jugadas que dije: 'Joder, este tiene esto'. Pues bueno, era un poco lo que buscábamos y vamos a ir generando contextos para Moscardo y para todos los que tenemos, para que mejoren en todas esas cosas”. Sobre el estado físico de Javi Puado: “Igual todavía es un poco pronto. Pero bueno, esta semana le va a venir muy bien para poder acumular un poquito de trabajo porque en su caso seguramente sí que le haga falta. Y es que es un líder, está comprometido, es uno de los capitanes. A mí me parece siempre un futbolista maravilloso. Y se lo he transmitido, porque todavía no había hablado cara a cara con él. No sé, un mesecito vamos a ponerle. Pero lo vamos a tener, lo vamos a tener bien y va a ser un jugador que va a disfrutar y que nos va a hacer disfrutar”.

articles.title: Jorge Jesus on Ronaldo’s unexpected retirement: ‘No, I don’t feel guilty about anything regarding his departure’
articles.summary: Jorge Jesus comments on Cristiano Ronaldo's unexpected retirement from international football after 21 years, addressing their disagreements and his role in the decision. Discover Ronaldo's legacy and contributions to Portugal's national team.
articles.body: Cristiano Ronaldo's international career has ended after 21 years, 234 appearances and a record 146 goals for Portugal, but the circumstances surrounding his departure have left questions about his relationship with head coach Jorge Jesus. The 41-year-old announced his retirement on Thursday, less than a month after walking out of the national team camp. Jesus has now addressed the fallout, insisting he was not responsible for the decision and had expected Ronaldo to return.Jorge Jesus denies responsibility for Ronaldo's international retirementJesus said he did not feel guilty about Ronaldo's decision to end his Portugal career, although he acknowledged that he might have acted too quickly during their disagreements. Speaking to reporters on Friday after announcing his squad for the upcoming Nations League matches against Denmark and Wales, the Portugal coach said the decision had ultimately come from the player himself."No, maybe I rushed things, but not because of me," Jesus said. "It was in his head, more call-ups, fewer call-ups."We also talked about it a few times. And if it was going to happen. But no, I don't feel guilty about anything regarding his departure. I respect his decision."Ronaldo announced his retirement on Thursday, bringing an end to a Portugal career that began in 2003. His 234 appearances and 146 goals remain records in men's international football, while his contribution to the national team includes the European Championship triumph in 2016 and two UEFA Nations League titles, in 2019 and 2025.The announcement came less than a month after the Portuguese Football Federation suspended him for 30 days and fined him €255 following his departure from the national team camp ahead of a Nations League fixture against Denmark on October 1.Ronaldo walked out after falling out with JesusThe disagreement between the two men developed during a difficult period for Portugal, following their round-of-16 exit at the 2026 World Cup. Jesus took charge of the national team in July after previously coaching Ronaldo at Al Nassr, where he guided the Saudi club to its first Saudi Pro League title during their time together.Ronaldo left the Portugal camp shortly before the Denmark fixture after a falling-out with Jesus. He subsequently apologised to his teammates for walking out and made clear that he wanted to continue representing his country, but he did not offer the same apology to the head coach.The forward then missed Portugal's next matches. He was an unused substitute in a 2-1 victory over Norway on October 4, the first time in 18 years that he had been left on the bench without being brought on for his country. His last appearance for Portugal was a 1-0 Nations League victory over Wales on September 24 in Lisbon.Despite the dispute, Jesus said he had expected Ronaldo to return and had intended to include him in the latest squad."I thought he would return," Jesus said. "I certainly intended to call him up."He felt that this was the right moment to leave, and that must be respected. We can never overlook what he has meant to Portugal, what he has contributed to the country, or the fact that he serves as a symbol for younger players."Jesus wanted Ronaldo to continue with PortugalJesus had discussed the possibility of international retirement with Ronaldo before the disagreement that led to the forward leaving camp. Speaking to Canal 11 on Friday, the coach said he had asked the captain to remain involved when they spoke in September, before his first squad announcement."We had the chance to talk about this before the first squad announcement [in September before the fallout]," he said. "I asked him to stay on with me because I needed him by my side."Their previous working relationship at Al Nassr had given Jesus an opportunity to understand Ronaldo's influence beyond his performances on the pitch. The coach described him as a figure whose importance extended well beyond the national team."I had the chance to spend a year working with him at Al Nassr," Jesus said. "Cris is a global icon, a Portuguese icon, and an icon of the national team."Ronaldo leaves international football having captained Portugal to their first major men's trophy at Euro 2016, followed by the inaugural Nations League title in 2019 and another triumph in 2025. His 146 goals and 234 appearances stand as the defining statistical record of his international career, which has now ended following a disagreement that neither player nor coach had publicly anticipated would bring it to a close.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Nebraska Fires OC Dana Holgorsen, Matt Rhule 'Angry' and 'Disappointed' with 2026 Results
articles.summary: Having lost four straight games in which the offense scored fewer than 20 points in all of them, Nebraska head coach Matt Rhule is making changes to try turning things around.
articles.body:
Having lost four straight games in which the offense scored fewer than 20 points in all of them, Nebraska head coach Matt Rhule is making changes to try turning things around.

In a statement released on Saturday (h/t ESPN's Max Olson ), Rhule announced the firing of offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen while expressing he is "angry" and "disappointed" with the team's results so far this season:

"Like so many of you, I am angry, I am disappointed and I am frustrated with our results this season. As the head coach, I am ultimately responsible for every aspect of our program — including wins and losses — and it is my responsibility to make changes when they are warranted. While there are many areas that need improvement, our offensive plan and execution is simply not working. While there are many areas that need improvement, our offensive plan and execution is simply not working."

The Cornhuskers started the season 5-0, though the schedule helped that because Ohio was the only FBS team they beat that currently has a winning record.

Nebraska's first loss of the season was a close 20-17 defeat against then-undefeated Indiana that suggested the program was making positive progress.

Any signs of progress have since been erased by an offense that has been able to get out of its own way. Nebraska has scored a total of 37 points in its last three games.

Friday night's loss to Illinois saw the Huskers rack up 426 yards, but that total was offset by two missed field goals and nine penalties called against the offense.

The problems in Lincoln go far beyond this season and the offense. Nebraska hasn't defeated a ranked opponent since Sept. 2016, a streak of 32 consecutive games after the loss to Indiana earlier this season.

Holgorsen has been the offensive coordinator for Nebraska since the 2024 season. The Huskers rank 55th among FBS teams in points per game this season, which is the highest mark of the Holgorsen era after finishing 59th last year and 103rd in 2024.

Rhule is midway through his fourth season as head coach at Nebraska. He has a 24-23 record overall with three games remaining this year.

Next up for the Cornhuskers is a matchup with Rutgers at SHI Stadium in New Jersey on Nov. 14.

articles.body: El Real Madrid reta a Mestalla para presionar al líder. Los de Mourinho, sin el sancionado Vinicius, quieren dormir en lo más alto ante un necesitado Valencia y sacar tajada del pulso en el Metropolitano... y lo hacen con el once del Clásico más Courtois. O lo que es lo mismo, el once favorito del portugués con Valverde de lateral. Ese es su sitio en este Madrid y parece complicado pensar que va a cambiar algo a lo largo de la temporada. Primera parte: Vaya paradón de Courtois para salvar al Madrid tras un error garrafal de Tchouaméni. El vuelo sin motor del belga es espectacular. NOTA DESCANSO: 9 Segunda parte: No ha tenido que aparecer en los primeros 20 minutos de la segunda parte. Y ahora paradón. Otro más del belga. Buena mano abajo para salvar al Madrid tras una gran jugada individual de Danjuma. NOTA FINAL: Primera parte: Y ahora le pitan otro fuera de juego a Valverde... que no era. No entiendo que el linier no espere para levantar el banderín. El segundo fuera de juego que no era. Otro latigazo de Valverde para firmar el 0-1. Controla, se ajusta el balón y a la jaula. Qué golpeo tiene el uruguayo, carajo. Qué pedazo de despliegue del capitán blanco. NOTA DESCANSO: 10 Segunda parte: Le da mucha amplitud al equipo, trabajo y juego por dentro. Lo tiene todo el uruguayo en esta posición... y, me atrevo a decir, que es el mejor lateral derecho del mundo. O al menos el más completo de todos. NOTA FINAL: Primera parte: Le pitan ahora una falta en ataque a Konaté... pero antes había un agarrón clarísimo a Bellingham dentro del área. No para de subir el nivel el francés desde hace unos cuantos partidos. NOTA DESCANSO: 8 Segunda parte: Qué gran robo de Konaté, que aguanta la carrera a Sadiq y luego le barre bien el balón. Top. Muy inteligente ahora el francés en un forcejeo con Aimar. Le cobran la falta al valencianista y Konaté lo celebra con todo. NOTA FINAL: Primera parte: Qué balón ha filtrado por dentro el central español, por favor. Una delicia. Va al suelo a la perfección para frenar a Maffeo, pero le pitan falta. Se cabrea Mourinho, que estaba al lado de la jugada. Otra gran acción de Huijsen en la salida de balón del Madrid. Gran primera parte de Huijsen. Ganando duelos, contundente y muy inteligente a la hora de dar salida. NOTA DESCANSO: 9 Segunda parte: Otro robo de Huijsen después de irse al suelo. Está saliendo de su zona de confort con mucha seguridad y confianza... y eso también es trabajo de Mourinho. NOTA FINAL: Primera parte: Muy incisivo en ataque. Pisa área, rompe a su par... y se la deja a Mbappé, que no consigue generar peligro. Otra falta clarísima de Maffeo sobre Cucurella, por detrás y a la altura de la rodilla... y no saca nada. Se le está yendo el partido al colegiado. Pura intensidad y un trabajo encomiable. Se está dejando ver mucho en ataque porque se entiende a la perfección con Diomande. NOTA DESCANSO: 8 Segunda parte: NOTA FINAL: Primera parte: La que había preparado el francés, que se duerme de espaldas y pierde el balón en la frontal del área. Le salva Courtois con una parada brillante. Disparo desde la frontal que no genera peligro. NOTA DESCANSO: 7 Segunda parte: el ancla del equipo... aunque le está costando con el balón en los pies. Tácticamente perfecto. NOTA FINAL: Primera parte: No está apareciendo mucho... y el Madrid le necesita. Se la regala a Diomande dentro del área, pero su disparo se marcha muy alto. Disfrutando de lo lindo porque el Madrid roba rápido y domina con mucha facilidad. NOTA DESCANSO: 7 Segunda parte: Muy desaparecido el portugués. No ha sido influyente en el juego blanco... pero suma mucho tener un futbolista al que los nervios no le juegan nunca una mala pasada. Se marcha en el 84' por Camavinga. NOTA FINAL: 6 Primera parte: Baja mucho a recibir el inglés para ayudar en la salida de balón. Otra buena acción en ataque de Jude, que se entiende con todos y mejora cada jugada cuando el balón pasa por su pies. Es único. Lo hace muy bien el 5 dentro del área. Se marcha en velocidad de Pepelu, pase atrás y gol de Arda. NOTA DESCANSO: 8 Segunda parte: El inglés es pura calidad y despliegue. Qué manera de morder ahora el Madrid tras pérdida. Eran tres jugadores los que habían saltado como leones a la presión... y la jugada acaba en robo. Es lo que tiene. Pufff que jugadón ahora del 5. Potencia pura para dejar a todos atrás y el balón no entra de milagro. NOTA FINAL: Primera parte: Taconazo mágico de Arda para dejar solito a Tchouaméni... pero el árbitro pita fuera de juego. No había nada. Otro gol del genio turco, que hace de 9 para empujar un balón al fondo de la red tras una gran jugada de Bellingham. Otro golpeo espectacular que despeja Dimitrievski. NOTA DESCANSO: 9 Segunda parte: Invente, Arda... invente. Genialidad del turco rodeado de futbolistas. La pisa, mete cuerpo, aguanta, recorta... y nadie le quita el balón. Vaya control de Arda Güler en un balón largo... pero luego no acierta a regatear al portero para marcar el tercero. Se lleva un duro pisotón tras ir al suelo para ayudar en defensa. Que auténtica bestialidad de Arda, que lucha por la posesión del balón... y, de espaldas y sin ver a Mbappé, le filtra un balón espectacular para dejarle sólo frente al portero. Increíble. Nadie entiende cómo ha visto a su compañero... el genio Arda Gudric, una mezcla entre Guti y Modric. Se marcha en el 84' por Brahim NOTA FINAL: 10 Primera parte: Cómo ha bajado a defender Diomande. Vaya diferencia y qué feliz es Cucurella cuando juega con el marfileño. Vaya roto de Diomande, que ha dejado sentados a Pepelu y Javi Guerra. Otra recuperación estelar de Diomande, que está en todos lados. Lo va a tener muy muy difícil Vinicius tras el parón. Otro que se empieza a entender con todos en ataque. Perdona su golito con un golpeo que se marcha muy alto. Otro pase por dentro que rompe líneas. NOTA DESCANSO: 9 Segunda parte: Ya le han cazado varias veces a Diomande... y esta última de Guido muy dura también. Por detrás, sin opciones de llegar al balón y a una altura peligrosa. Se alaba mucho su trabajo... pero es que el marfileño es muy completo. Y si encima trabajas y ayudas al equipo, pues tus compañeros te lo agradecen. Otra carrera para morder al rival. Es una bestia. Se marcha en el 84' por Endrick. NOTA FINAL: 9 Primera parte: Si hay algo que se le pueda reprochar a Mbappé es que nunca intenta ganar un duelo aéreo... pero es que ni siquiera salta para al menos molestar. Cae Mbappé dentro del área... pero no parece nada. Algo más que el último que le pitaron, que no era nada. Y otra de Maffeo, que está vez si ve la amarilla tras frenar al francés cuando se quedaba solo en el mano a mano ante el portero. Falta en la frontal para el 10 que manda a la barrera. Se quedaba solo Mbappé, pero estaba en fuera de juego. NOTA DESCANSO: 7 Segunda parte: Se sube a la moto Mbappé, deja atrás a todos... pero su pase de la muerte no lo caza ningún compañero. Perdona Mbappé el 0-3 en una acción que pedía a gritos la vaselina. Otra que perdona el francés y ya van varias. Le regala el gol Arda... y el francés no perdona. El 0-3 del Madrid tras regatear al portero y mandar el balón al fondo de la red. Y ahora provoca la roja a Gayá, que le ha ido a cazar. Está el Valencia desquiciado. NOTA FINAL: Primera parte: Otra gran primera parte de sus hombres para irse al descanso con buena ventaja en el marcador... y un buen fútbol sobre el césped. No se fueron del partido, cuando lo fácil era todo lo contrario tras las continuas faltas del Valencia, que llegaban tarde y dejaban la pierna. Buena presión tras pérdida, mucha movilidad en ataque y un ritmo que ha dejado sin soluciones al rival. Gran primera parte del Madrid con el once de gala de Mou. articles.title: Árbitro salió de la Liga BetPlay y no volvería a pitar este año
articles.standfirst: Luis Matorel habría recibido un duro castigo después de sus incontables errores en el campeonato
articles.summary: Luis Matorel habría recibido un duro castigo después de sus incontables errores en el campeonato
articles.body: La posible salida de Luis Matorel del arbitraje nacional se convirtió en uno de los temas más comentados del fútbol colombiano a pocos días del inicio de los cuadrangulares de la Liga BetPlay. Según información difundida por el exárbitro Wilmer Barahona, el juez bolivarense habría sido apartado de las designaciones por “reiterados errores”, siendo el más visible el episodio en el que Jaguares de Córdoba jugó con 12 futbolistas durante unos segundos ante Millonarios. La noticia, sin embargo, debe matizarse: hasta el momento la Federación Colombiana de Fútbol no habría anunciado públicamente una sanción formal contra Matorel. Lo que sí es verificable es que el árbitro no apareció en las designaciones de la fecha 18 de la Liga BetPlay DIMAYOR II-2026, publicadas el 5 de noviembre, pese a que en fechas anteriores seguía siendo tenido en cuenta para partidos de alta exigencia. El hecho ocurrió en el estadio Nemesio Camacho El Campín, durante la fecha 15 de la Liga BetPlay DIMAYOR II-2026, cuando Millonarios venció 4-1 a Jaguares de Córdoba. Al minuto 77, Jaguares realizó un cambio: Santiago Cubides entró por Jonathan Lovera, pero durante unos segundos ambos permanecieron dentro del terreno de juego. La situación fue detectada por jugadores de Millonarios y por periodistas presentes en el estadio. El periodista Alejandro Gamboa publicó una imagen en la que se apreciaba a 12 futbolistas de Jaguares dentro de la cancha, lo que encendió de inmediato las críticas contra Matorel y su cuerpo arbitral. Aunque el error no tuvo consecuencias directas en el marcador —el partido terminó 4-1 a favor de Millonarios—, la imagen se volvió viral y abrió un debate sobre la concentración y el control que debe tener un árbitro central durante las sustituciones. En un partido profesional, permitir que un equipo tenga un jugador adicional en cancha, aunque sea por pocos segundos, es considerado una falla reglamentaria grave, pues rompe la igualdad de condiciones que debe garantizar el árbitro. Según Wilmer Barahona, exárbitro que sigue de cerca los movimientos del gremio, Matorel habría sido retirado del arbitraje nacional para lo que resta del campeonato. Barahona afirmó en su cuenta de X que la decisión “sacude el arbitraje” debido a la larga trayectoria de Matorel y a la confianza que la cúpula de la comisión tenía en él. La evidencia más concreta de esta supuesta sanción es que, en las designaciones arbitrales de la fecha 18 publicadas por la FCF el 5 de noviembre, el nombre de Luis Matorel no apareció en ninguno de los 10 partidos programados. Otros árbitros que también han protagonizado polémicas este semestre, como Carlos Ortega, Jhon Alexander Ospina, Bismarks Santiago y Wilmar Roldán, sí fueron designados para esa fecha, lo que refuerza la idea de que la ausencia de Matorel no es casual. Este caso no ocurre en el vacío. El arbitraje colombiano viene atravesando una crisis de credibilidad, con múltiples errores señalados por clubes, jugadores, periodistas y aficionados a lo largo del semestre. La decisión de retirar a Matorel, si se confirma oficialmente, sería una de las medidas más drásticas tomadas por la Comisión Arbitral en lo que va del torneo. Los cuadrangulares de la Liga BetPlay están a punto de iniciar, y la presión sobre los árbitros será mayor que nunca. Cada error en esta fase puede definir campeonatos, descensos y clasificaciones a torneos internacionales, por lo que la FCF parece estar enviando un mensaje claro: no habrá tolerancia con fallos que comprometan la integridad de la competencia.
